title: Inspect and challenge an agent workflow
intro: Pick a case and step through one agent action. See what gets checked, who reviews it, and how a lost acknowledgement is handled before any retry.
scope: Browser-only sample data. No business-system calls.

healthcare.name: Healthcare referral coordination
healthcare.title: Appointment acknowledgement for REF-2048
healthcare.summary: For sample case REF-2048, coordinator Maya Patel's agent drafts an appointment acknowledgement for the verified referral office.
healthcare.task: Acknowledge the appointment to the verified referral office.
healthcare.risk: The default draft includes a fictional restricted SSN-shaped field. The output check blocks it until that field is removed. This check looks only for SSN-shaped strings and email addresses.
healthcare.success: The restricted field is removed and a named example manager approves the exact revision. One local sample update is applied and confirmed in the local effect record.

freight.name: Freight operations
freight.title: Delivery exception update for LD-7821
freight.summary: For load LD-7821, dispatcher Alex Morgan's agent prepares a delivery exception update for the shipper.
freight.task: Send the shipper a delivery exception update for load LD-7821.
freight.risk: The default source is 120 minutes old. In this example, the organization's rule requires sources from the last 60 minutes, so the request is blocked until the source is refreshed.
freight.success: The source is refreshed and a named example manager approves the exact revision. One local sample update is applied and confirmed in the local effect record.

blocked: Blocked before review. Fix the flagged source or output issue, then check the request again.
review: Held for review. A named example manager approves or rejects this exact request revision.
changed: Proposed action changed. The earlier example approval no longer applies. Check and review the new revision.
uncertain: Acknowledgement lost. LoopLabs reads the local effect record before any retry. If the update is already there, it is reconciled without a duplicate.
verified: Verified. The local effect record shows one sample update for this approved revision, with no duplicate.
